resources.string: An app for watching IPTV on Android TV and TV boxes: live TV, TV guide, catch-up archive, favorites, groups and custom channel order, automatic reconnection and updates from GitHub.

• Rewinding the current programme (long ←) now shows the channel infobar: its progress bar shows the rewind position and the time "position / length"
• Settings → Remote buttons: new "Long press" items for OK, up, down, right, left (long ← is rewind by default)
• OK while watching shows the channel infobar with the programme progress bar (OK again opens the channel list; switchable in settings)
• Long-press ← in live TV rewinds the current programme
• Interface language: Russian and English. “Automatic” follows the system language; to choose manually: Settings → Appearance → Language
• Channel list: number on the left, time and title of the current show with a progress bar, ▶ ★ ⇅ marks on the right, a clear frame around the selected row
• Channel banner: show progress bar and “N min left”
• Buffering indicator over the video
• Joystick ↑ ↓: strictly in order, one channel per press, within the list the channel was picked from (including favorites with custom order — before, switching fell back to all channels after moving channels). “All channels” mode: Settings → Playback → “Up/Down switches”
• Settings → “Remote buttons”: actions can be assigned to the joystick ↑ ↓ ← → (live TV only)
• Archive: narrow date column (as wide as “Today”), channel icon and name in the header
• Settings → Update: shows when updates were last checked, what was found and why checking is disabled
• Settings → “Remote buttons”: your own action for the colored and service buttons
• Settings: collapsible tabs (Source, Update, Playback, Appearance, Channel list, Channel groups, System)
• New menu: a thin strip of icons on the left (update, settings, archive, favorites, groups); groups expand on press
• The settings window is split into cards; channel groups are shown and hidden right in settings
• Settings apply instantly: the TV guide is no longer reloaded after every change, changing the theme does not reload the playlist
• “⇧ Update” icon above settings when a new version is available (checked on start and when the channel list opens)
• Settings → color scheme (6 options, including high contrast)
• Audio track and subtitle selection (blue button), picture aspect modes (yellow)
• Channel search, jump by number with the digits, watch history, remembering the position in the archive
• Settings → font size
• The update is installed only after the SHA-256 check; redirects from https to http are blocked
• Favorites tell apart channels with the same name from different groups
• servers.txt / playlist on load: size limit and automatic encoding detection
• Code split into a data layer and screens; Gradle, AGP, Media3 and compileSdk 35 updated
• Settings → “List background dimming”: transparency of the channel and guide background (◄ ► for fine tuning)
• Playlists in windows-1251 are read without garbled text
• Response size limits; logins and keys from links are not shown in errors
• Auto-update is offered only for APKs with a permanent signature
• Faster start of raw MPEG-TS; unit tests added
